root_cause_criterion.description: Before `make_hI()` evaluates `hl[j][k - 1]` and `hl[j][k]`, the search loop must leave `k >= 1`. The vulnerable original reaches the protected interpolation with `k == 0`; the fixed original executes the same interpolation with `k == 1` because the loop starts at 1.

nodes.state: At the interpolation sink, `k - 1` is -1 in the vulnerable original, so the expression `hl[j][k - 1]` reads before the beginning of the 361-entry row.

edges.description: The value of `k` produced by the search loop is used unchanged by the immediately following interpolation, carrying the vulnerable `k == 0` state directly to the sink expression.
